title: permodel-key-allowlist tests assert a design MPI-336 deliberately replaced
description: Three of the nine standing test failures come from tests/permodel-key-allowlist.test.cjs, and they are STALE TESTS, not a code defect. They demand that every scope perModel control appear in _MODEL_WIDE_KEYS in js/services/projectService.js, which genuinely holds only {loras, upscaleModel} - but projectService.js:209-213 documents that MPI-336 deliberately REPLACED that hand-maintained allowlist with a modelWide flag derived from the control own scope. Live proof from the MPI-346 verification run: the sidecar carried controlState.model.krea2Turbo false, so the runtime path is correct. A fourth assertion fails separately with parsed zero snapshotted keys - the regex has drifted, which is genuine source-text drift. Rewrite the file to assert the real contract or delete it. Do NOT add the keys to _MODEL_WIDE_KEYS to make it green - that reinstates the list MPI-336 removed. Also carries the remaining six uncharacterised failures as a follow-on question.
